title: Conditional flow matching in acute human wounds: analysis software
description: Analysis software for a three-donor audit of population reconstruction by conditional flow matching in acute human wounds. Product-coupled fields operate in a frozen 15-dimensional expression representation. The study distinguishes global time holdout from donor transfer and compares endpoint controls, training-target marginals, paired clocks, distribution shape and observed expression. Simple permitted-data predictors outperform flow in important comparisons. The study does not identify individual cell trajectories or validate clinical wound prognosis. This software archive contains MIT-licensed analysis programs, model definitions, acquisition helpers, tests and environment specifications. Public processed inputs are identified by GEO accession in the reproduction guide. The complete reproduction package, with manuscript, editable figures, frozen weights and numerical results, is available from this project's versioned GitHub release.
